Sendbird Live Sample is an application designed for the simplest implementation of Sendbird Live UIKit to showcase the capabilities of Sendbird Live SDK.
Prerequisites:
- A Sendbird account (Sign up on dashboard.sendbird.com)
- A QR code generated in Live studio from Sendbird Dashboard
Features:
- Fast login using a QR Code
- View a list of ongoing live events
- Create and host new live events
- View live events and chat with other participants
Note: This sample application is intended for developers and Sendbird customers to quickly and easily try out Sendbird Live. It is not intended to be used as a general-purpose communications tool.

This app costs nothing to use.
